canonical_statement: The trial compared long-term morbidity and mortality with LCZ696 versus enalapril in patients with chronic heart failure and reduced ejection fraction.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We compared the angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitor LCZ696 with enalapril in patients who had heart failure with a reduced ejection fraction.

canonical_statement: PARADIGM-HF was a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, parallel-group, active-controlled phase III trial.

source_anchor.page: Protocol PDF p. 95 / amended protocol v04 section 4.1

canonical_statement: Before randomization, eligible patients underwent sequential single-blind run-in treatment with enalapril 10 mg twice daily and then LCZ696 titrated to 200 mg twice daily; only patients tolerating both target regimens were randomized.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients who had no unacceptable side effects of the target doses of the two study medications were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio

canonical_statement: Randomization used a concealed computerized system with 1:1 assignment to LCZ696 200 mg twice daily or enalapril 10 mg twice daily.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to double-blind treatment with either enalapril ... or LCZ696 ... with the use of a computerized randomization system involving concealed study-group assignments.

canonical_statement: Clinical endpoints were adjudicated in blinded fashion by a clinical-endpoints committee using prespecified criteria.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Adjudication of these outcomes was carried out in a blinded fashion by a clinical-end-points committee according to prespecified criteria.

canonical_statement: The primary analysis used stratified Cox proportional-hazards models and stratified log-rank testing; KCCQ was analyzed with a repeated-measures covariance model and a score of zero was assigned after death.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We assessed the consistency of the treatment effect among 18 prespecified subgroups and used a repeated-measures covariance model to evaluate the KCCQ score ... a score of zero was used for patients who had died.

canonical_statement: The event-driven trial planned two interim efficacy analyses and prespecified early termination for efficacy or safety; the trial was stopped early after the efficacy boundary was crossed.

canonical_statement: Eligible patients were adults aged at least 18 years with chronic heart failure and NYHA class II-IV symptoms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Eligibility requirements at screening included an age of at least 18 years, New York Heart Association (NYHA) class II, III, or IV symptoms

canonical_statement: The LVEF eligibility threshold was initially 40% or less and was amended on December 15, 2010 to 35% or less.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: modify the left ventricular ejection fraction entry criterion from ≤40% to ≤35%

canonical_statement: Natriuretic-peptide entry criteria required BNP at least 150 pg/mL or NT-proBNP at least 600 pg/mL, with lower thresholds of BNP at least 100 pg/mL or NT-proBNP at least 400 pg/mL after a heart-failure hospitalization within the prior 12 months.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients were required to have a plasma B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) level of at least 150 pg per milliliter ... or, if they had been hospitalized for heart failure within the previous 12 months, a BNP of at least 100 pg per milliliter

population.label: Screening population
inclusion_criteria: BNP ≥150 pg/mL or NT-proBNP ≥600 pg/mL; lower threshold with recent HF hospitalization

canonical_statement: Before screening, patients were required to be receiving stable beta-blocker therapy and an ACE inhibitor or ARB at a dose equivalent to at least enalapril 10 mg daily for at least 4 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: for at least 4 weeks before screening, patients were required to take a stable dose of a beta-blocker and an ACE inhibitor (or ARB) equivalent to at least 10 mg of enalapril daily.

inclusion_criteria: Stable beta-blocker and ACEI/ARB background therapy for ≥4 weeks

canonical_statement: Key exclusions included symptomatic hypotension or low systolic blood pressure (<100 mm Hg at screening or <95 mm Hg at randomization), eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², excessive eGFR decline during run-in, hyperkalemia above protocol thresholds, and a history of angioedema or unacceptable ACEI/ARB adverse effects.
